market_validation.public_note: No betting instruction is generated; market gaps stay visible instead of being filled with synthetic odds.

factor_policy.name: Open-Meteo
factor_policy.role: weather, wind and heat context adjust total-goal tempo, not home/away direction

factor_policy.name: technical process metrics
factor_policy.role: seed-derived possession, shots, xG and PPDA now nudge expected goals with proxy penalty

factor_policy.name: player availability
factor_policy.role: QDR, key dependency and rotation capacity nudge expected goals with proxy penalty

factor_policy.name: style matchup
factor_policy.role: press-vs-buildup, set pieces and transition matchup nudge expected goals

factor_policy.name: Asian handicap closing line
factor_policy.role: true market line, closing line, CLV and ROI backtest require a licensed odds source

factor_policy.name: deduplicated match market ensemble
factor_policy.role: latest price per bookmaker is de-vigged and blended into the score matrix; raw model disagreement stays visible

factor_policy.name: World Cup rolling form
factor_policy.role: recency-weighted points, goal difference, shots on target, opponent strength and corners from completed tournament matches

factor_policy.name: corner count distribution
factor_policy.role: team-for/opponent-against rolling rates with empirical-Bayes shrinkage and a negative-binomial tail

backtest.method: Formal accuracy uses predictions preserved at least five minutes before kickoff; CLV remains unavailable until a price is captured inside the closing window.

asian_handicap.selection_policy: maximum one pre-kickoff edge-qualified market per match

public_reference_gate.policy: Keep probabilities visible, but do not emit a directional public lean for markets that fail locked-sample validation.

notes: No sample is counted unless the prediction was locked before kickoff.
CLV is only calculated against a snapshot captured inside the configured closing window.

shadow.label: 公式烟测，不作为专业模型成绩

model_comparison.promotion_rule: Promote only when the candidate lowers both log-loss and Brier on at least 40 settled samples.

factor_gate.policy: Only backtested factors can raise core model weight; proxy factors stay display-only or receive a confidence penalty.

requirements_to_claim_professional: Closing snapshots within 5-10 minutes of kickoff
Stable Brier/log-loss calibration by market type
